Page 257 
Brand Over Generic Not Covered 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-99590  
Guideline Name 
Brand Over Generic Not Covered  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
12/9/2021  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Generic products on a brand* over generic program  
Guideline Type 
Administrative  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Requests for a generic product on a brand over generic program (presence of Brand over 
generic-Not Covered clinical program in formulary lookup) shall be denied. The plan’s 
preferred product is the brand medication.  
Notes  
* Brand product may require prior authorization.
